title: Add asymmetric latency degradation isolation and autoretry rollout gate
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We've seen a class of regressions where tail-latency increases only for a subset of traffic (by route, tenant, or model-version) while aggregate metrics remain within SLOs. These asymmetric degradations are hard for existing canaries to detect and often lead to slow burn incidents during rollouts.

What this PR adds: a new perf-canary rollout gate (Asymmetric Degradation Isolation + Autoretry Gate) that: 1) computes slice-aware tail-latency deltas (p95/p99) between baseline and candidate over overlapping time windows; 2) identifies statistically significant asymmetric regressions concentrated in small traffic cohorts; 3) applies a low-cost isolation action (traffic quarantine + sticky routing to baseline) and an autoretry backoff to candidate hosts while the detection window closes; 4) emits detailed telemetry to the Console for fast debugging and automatic rollback if quarantine persists.

Key algorithmic details: the detector uses a weighted two-sample bootstrap on latency fingerprints per slice, prioritizing slices by contribution-to-tail (CTT) score rather than raw request count. We ignore slices under a min-traffic floor (configurable) and apply a temporal smoothing factor that decays older observations. Isolation policy supports three modes: probe-only (dry run), partial-quarantine (isolate top-K offending slices, redirect X% of their traffic), and full-quarantine (move all slice traffic to baseline variant). Autoretry implements exponential backoff with jitter and a max-retry-window; retries are routed to candidates only after the window stabilizes.

Config surface: the gate exposes these knobs via rollout spec: detection_window_sec, min_slice_rps, ctt_threshold, p_value_threshold, quarantine_mode, partial_quarantine_fraction, autoretry_backoff_sec, max_retries, and monitoring_channel (teams/alerting). Default values are conservative to avoid noisy isolations.

Telemetry and observability: new events and metrics (perf_canary.slice_ctt, perf_canary.slice_p99_delta, perf_canary.quarantine_rate, perf_canary.autoretry_attempts) are emitted. The Console adds a per-rollout slice map visualization and timeline so SREs and engineers can immediately see which slices triggered isolation. We also add an internal debug trace for sampled requests to follow routing decisions.

Testing and rollout plan: unit tests for detector statistics and end-to-end integration tests using the perf-canary lab harness are included. We staged rollout behind a feature flag; initial rollout was probe-only for 48h against internal traffic, followed by gradual enablement of partial-quarantine for non-critical tenants. The README documents safe defaults and guidance.

Risk/rollback: the quarantine is conservative (defaults to probe-only). Partial-quarantine caps traffic moved to baseline to avoid capacity shocks. If autoretry symptoms persist beyond configurable tolerance, the gate escalates to automatic rollback (via existing rollout controller).

Related: ENG-4321 (investigate asymmetric tail regressions), ENG-4389 (rollout gate framework updates).

review_comments: Jonah Kim: Nice approach. Can you explain why you chose bootstrap vs. Welch's t-test? I worry about small-sample slices. Request: add a short justification in the detector doc and a micro-benchmark showing statistical power.

Asha Patel: Reply: bootstrap handles heavy-tailed latency distributions better in our lab signals; added a micro-benchmark to perf-canary/docs comparing both approaches and thresholds tuned for n>=50 samples.
Priya Desai: Please add an integration test that simulates an intermittent backend degradation so we can validate autoretry jitter behavior.
Asha Patel: Added intermittent scenario test and tuned backoff default to include jitter and a cap.
Lukas Weber: Lgtm. One nit: move the governance knobs to rollout_controller.go's central config for consistency.
Asha Patel: Moved ctt_threshold and min_slice_rps into central config and left other gate-specific knobs inline.
merge_outcome: Merged by squash-merge after approval from reviewers. Changelog entry created under perf-canary/CHANGELOG.md.
release_notes: Add asymmetric latency isolation gate: detects and quarantines small-slice tail regressions to protect rollouts
Introduce autoretry backoff with jitter for candidate hosts during quarantine
New Console slice map visualization and telemetry for forensic debugging
